text: As she walked through the heat, an ancient baobab tree bent its thick branches and groaned in the wind: 'Young traveler, my bark is choked with dry parasite vines.
Most travelers would have hurried past, but Kumba climbed the trunk and patiently stripped the choking vines away.
'May your steps be blessed,' the baobab whispered, showering sweet white fruit into her apron.
Further along, a small herd of gazelles was trapped in thorny brambles; Kumba gently parted the thorns, accepting nothing but their grateful eyes before continuing her lonely trek.
